reviewItem.question: For "Line removed from cmd/crossplane/core/core.go: log.Info(\"Composition Revisions are GA and cannot be disabled. The --enable-composition-revisions flag will be…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: In v2.0.0 the Crossplane core command no longer emits the startup log line "Composition Revisions are GA and cannot be disabled. The --enable-composition-revisions flag will be removed in a future release." — the deprecation warning for the --enable-composition-revisions flag (already a no-op since Composition Revisions are GA) was removed from cmd/crossplane/core/core.go.
